title: Varus and Leona are swapped
prompt: Stage 2-2. You lost the last fight in eight seconds and cannot see why. Look at the board: one swap fixes it. Pick the two units that should trade hexes.
explanation:
Varus is a ranged carry standing in the front row, so he is the first unit the enemy melee reaches and he dies before he casts. Leona is a tank standing in the back row, so she does nothing until everyone in front of her is dead. Swap them: Leona to the front next to Kobuko, Varus to the back next to Karma.

This happens more than you think, usually after a carousel or an item move drops a unit on the wrong hex. Before every fight, glance at the two rows: is every melee unit in front of every ranged one?
principle: Ranged in the back, melee in the front. Check it every round, not just when you build the board.
commonMistake: Blaming the loss on the enemy having a stronger board and rolling to fix a problem that was two hexes wide.
